description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketBpsData operation to query network bandwidth data for a domain name that uses the WebSocket protocol
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketBpsData查询域名WebSocket协议的网络带宽监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-domain-websocket-bps-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2017-12-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T21:00:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketBpsData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name.

Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). By default, this operation queries all accelerated domain names
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名。

多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔，默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity for the query. Unit: seconds.

The time granularity varies based on the maximum time range per query. Valid values are 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). For more information, see the "Usage notes" section
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，单位为秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）取值，具体请参见使用说明中支持查询的时间粒度
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The name of the carrier.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html operation to query carriers. By default, this operation queries all carriers
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html接口获取，默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The name of the region.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html operation to query regions. By default, this operation queries all regions
parameters.help_zh:
地域商英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html接口获取，默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en
